scope: Add direct AC1024 ASCII/Binary allocation-failure sweeps for BLOCKLINEARPARAMETER, BLOCKHORIZONTALCONSTRAINTPARAMETER, and BLOCKVERTICALCONSTRAINTPARAMETER, including caller/source identity rollback, references, and retry/readback.

change.testCoverage: Three generated two-point parameter profiles cover linear bounds and value arrays, plus horizontal/vertical constraint variants with a remapped dependency handle, expression metadata, flags, bounds, increment, and allowed values. Each includes the shared two-point fields and nested property vectors.
change.perEncoding: Each of the three profiles exercises 14 ASCII and 14 Binary allocation offsets. Every injected failure preserves caller fields and removes partial source identity. Fresh-writer retry reads back the owner/dependency roles, points, property state/code/name order, subtype-specific values, and subclass.
change.existingAdapterControl: The existing dwg2dxf_dynamic_block_two_point_parameter_writer test passes for the supported generated two-point parameter family.

limitations: Fault injection covers each low-level record writer, not the enclosing whole-file transaction.
A fresh writer is used after failure because the failed writer may retain partial stream bytes and a sticky error.
Generated transaction controls do not qualify physical producer breadth, recursive graph closure, or native constraint evaluation.
No DWG/DXF fixture is added and no support claim is promoted.
nextReadyPacket: Continue P6 residual semantic/version work rather than infer production support from generated caller-state controls.
